#!/bin/bash
for i in $(mpc listall | cut -f1 -d'/' | sort | uniq); do
  echo $i
  mpc clear
  mpc rm $i
  mpc add $i/
  mpc shuffle
  mpc save $i
done
echo "We created:"
mpc lsplaylist
mpc load $(mpc lsplaylist | shuf | head -n1)
mpc play

source_directories:
    - /minecraft
repositories:
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_DEFAULT_DOMAIN}//opt/local/minecraft
    label: onsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
  - path: ssh://backup@nas.${SECRET_OFFSITE_DOMAIN}//opt/backup/minecraft
    label: offsite
    append_only: true
    make_parent_directories: true
ssh_command: ssh -i /home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
archive_name_format: minecraft-{now}
